topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: The trees sway gently, a familiar whisper among the leaves. This morning, the air is crisp and carries the scent of rain not yet fallen. I’ve noticed something different about the clearing near the stream; a new richness, a fuller, greener hue to the plants. Perhaps a hidden spring has nourished this spot, unknown until now. It’s a discovery that makes my steps lighter, my breath easier. I’ve shared this.finding with those who pass, a nod here, a flick of the tail there. They, too, seem to notice, their movements more deliberate, their interest piqued. We all know this place will be a good spot to linger, to rest, to find what we need. The forest has its secrets, and today, we are a little closer to each other, a little richer in the knowledge of our shared home.
